name: The Third Troll Legend
summary: At the Ruins of Zul'Kunda, the Third Troll Legend is one of four tablet transcriptions Brother Nimetz seeks. He hopes the old markings will shed light on Colonel Kurzen's corruption.

sections.title: Stone in Zul'Kunda
sections.body: Among the roofless rooms of the Ruins of Zul'Kunda, the Third Troll Legend lies on a stone tablet called Fall of Gurubashi. Its markings are sought by Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp. He is studying four troll legends for a possible link to Colonel Kurzen's corruption.

faq.q: What is the Third Troll Legend?
faq.answer: The Third Troll Legend is a transcription of markings from the Fall of Gurubashi tablet in the Ruins of Zul'Kunda.

faq.q: Where is the Fall of Gurubashi tablet?
faq.answer: The Fall of Gurubashi tablet is in the southwestern room of the Ruins of Zul'Kunda, on the plateau.

faq.q: Who wants the Third Troll Legend?
faq.answer: Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp seeks the four troll legends to study their possible connection to Colonel Kurzen's corruption.

faq.q: Why is Brother Nimetz collecting troll legends?
faq.answer: Brother Nimetz suspects troll magic may have a connection to Colonel Kurzen's corruption, and hopes the legends will help him investigate.

angles.text: Brother Nimetz's concern is Colonel Kurzen, an Alliance officer whose corruption has alarmed him. The legends may help explain what befell Kurzen.
